cases.explain: The verb восхвалю (I will praise) takes the accusative case, which for the animate noun Господь is identical to the genitive form Господа.

cases.translation: My soul shall boast in the Lord.
cases.explain: The noun душа is the grammatical subject of the verb будет хвалиться, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: delivered me from all my fears.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: their faces shall never be covered with shame.
cases.explain: The noun стыд is the nominative subject of the verb покроет (will cover).
The verb удерживай (keep) takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The preposition от (from) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: ___ Господень ополчается вокруг тех, кто боится Господа.
cases.translation: Yahweh's angel encamps around those who fear him.
cases.explain: The noun ангел is the nominative subject of the verb ополчается (encamps).
The verb ищи (seek) can take the genitive case when expressing a search for something.

reading.ru: Восхвалю Господа во всякое время, хвала ему всегда на устах моих.
reading.question: According to the text, what should be on the psalmist's lips at all times?
reading.explain: The text states хвала ему всегда на устах моих (praise to him always on my lips).

reading.ru: Я искал Господа, и Он мне ответил, и от всех моих страхов меня избавил.
reading.question: How did the Lord respond when the psalmist sought Him?
options: He answered and delivered from fears
reading.correct: He answered and delivered from fears
reading.explain: The text explicitly says Он мне ответил и от всех моих страхов меня избавил (He answered me and delivered me from all my fears).

reading.ru: Кусите и увидите, как благ Господь.
reading.question: What does the psalmist invite people to do to understand God's goodness?
reading.explain: The text says Кусите и увидите, как благ Господь (Taste and see that the Lord is good).

reading.ru: Бойтесь Господа, святые его, ведь кто боится его, ни в чем не нуждается.
reading.question: According to the text, what do those who fear the Lord lack?
reading.explain: The text states кто боится его, ни в чем не нуждается (those who fear him lack nothing).

reading.ru: Придите, дети, послушайте меня, я научу вас страху Господню.
reading.question: What does the psalmist offer to teach the children?
reading.explain: The text says я научу вас страху Господню (I will teach you the fear of the Lord).

reading.ru: Удаляйся от зла и твори добро, ищи мира и стремись к нему.
reading.question: What two actions should a person take according to this verse?
options: Depart from evil and do good
reading.correct: Depart from evil and do good
reading.explain: The text explicitly commands Удаляйся от зла и твори добро (Depart from evil and do good).
